delivery: Local, uncommitted; not installed on Eagle 1, uploaded, or published. Existing owner edits preserved.
behavior: Routine startup opens available on-device history without the sole-owner network preflight. Normal CloudKit synchronization remains enabled.

Retained-history inspection or explicitly authorized restoration still runs on next launch, with a Continue Without iCloud Check control. Cancellation waits for the temporary storage owner to release its stores before local opening.

An unreadable-history screen offers explicit Continue with New Local History. The new on-disk full-schema store is selected durably before app views can write. Original history files and journals remain untouched.
Subsequent launches keep the continued history; there is no automatic switch back to old files or automatic merge.
Coach photos, weight anchors, archive recovery files and active-run checkpoints/identity keys are separated for continued history.
Backup restore failures appear in a dismissible Home notice rather than an automatic blocking alert.
Unapproved restore reviews remain available after ordinary relaunch; consumed/rejected reviews do not offer a stale restore button.
continued_history_selection: CoachLocalOwnership/ContinuedHistory/selection.json binds a UUID-relative directory to its actual persistent store identity. Missing or invalid selections do not silently choose another empty database.

verification.target: iPhone 17 Pro Simulator, iOS 26.5; synthetic isolated histories only
verification.ui_flow: Unreadable original history -> explicit continuation -> Home -> save 88 weight entry -> terminate -> relaunch -> same entry visible and searchable
verification.cancellation: Injected pending cloud check canceled through actual controller; existing local weight identity retained, no live CloudKit calls
verification.backup: New continued-history export and actual import retained the exact weight identity
verification.release_build: Passed: unsigned generic iOS Release, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

limits: No physical-device installation or live iCloud convergence was tested.
Continued history does not itself recover, merge, or display unreadable older history. Keep the app installed and export new entries before recovery work.
A device unable to create or save durable storage can still reject continuation; the app does not offer writable in-memory storage as if it were saved history.
Existing compiler warnings and SwiftUI invalid-frame navigation warnings remain.
earlier_attempts: Two initial builds exposed actor-isolation errors; corrected using a synchronized immutable-path snapshot rather than weakening actor checks.

The initial continuation UI assertion failed because the parent accessibility identifier replaced the button identifier. Added container accessibility semantics; the final real UI save/relaunch flow passed.

One CLI test run finished test execution but hung while finalizing its result bundle. Its exact process was stopped; no completed bundle from that run is claimed. Later XcodeBuildMCP runs completed with readable results.
